candidateSource.profile: Giant Killer (#9); base class Ranger, Soldier, or Warrior (Lv 10+).
candidateSource.sourceText: Anchor Chain: Hurl a rune-harpoon to ground flying or leaping foes — ranged attack (30 ft) tethers one Large+ target; on hit, speed halved and flight suspended until they break the chain (Str save vs. tier DC) or you release it (bonus action).
candidateSource.draftStatus: The hallmark is not marked in draftHallmarkIndices. draftCapstone=true applies to the separate capstone.
candidateSource.authorityCaveat: The file is a printed ability lead. This binding alone does not establish an accepted operational procedure or a particular character's acquisition/access.

directorRuling.finding: The printed tether, speed reduction, and flight suspension do not specify how Reverse Gravity loads or moves a tethered target. Suspending flight does not establish immunity to upward movement caused by Reverse Gravity. The Strength escape save supplies no load, anchor-strength, or breakage calculation.
directorRuling.additionalBoundary: The preserved anchored U record does not establish Large+ eligibility; do not relabel or replace that parent.
requiredEvidence: Explicit source authority connecting Anchor Chain to Reverse Gravity: whether it stops upward movement, with attachment/anchor conditions, and how slack, failure, and release settle.
A complete lawful attachment/support record, or an explicit accepted ability rule explaining why a conventional rated assembly is unnecessary.
Qualified Giant Killer acquisition/unlock, current activation budgets/costs, attack and tier-DC derivation, and an eligible Large+ target.
Integrated movement, release/fall, and cargo/custody settlement.
directorRuling.safeNextStep: Record this as a distinct Anchor Chain candidate, then seek the accepted procedure or clarification establishing the missing interaction. Do not build a witness from 'ground' or 'flight suspended' alone.

retainedState.queuePriority: Reverse Gravity Field remains first; Eternal Prophecy follows after its completion.
